purpose: Freeze the complete blind H1 screening instructions, including the exact database vocabulary that the narrative brief previously described but did not enumerate.

exclusion_reason_vocabulary.E_LANGUAGE_NON_ENGLISH: The original title, abstract, full text, or explicit source-language metadata is non-English.
exclusion_reason_vocabulary.E_NOT_PAPER_LEVEL_INNOVATION_OR_POTENTIA: The record does not study scientific-paper novelty, innovation, or publication-time potential scholarly impact.
exclusion_reason_vocabulary.E_FUTURE_OUTCOME_ONLY: The record discusses only a post-publication outcome and supplies no relevant construct, validation design, or T0 predictor.
exclusion_reason_vocabulary.E_NOT_ARTICLE_LEVEL: The analytical unit is an author, journal, institution, country, field, corpus, or other aggregate rather than an individual scientific paper.
exclusion_reason_vocabulary.E_NOT_INDICATOR_PREDICTOR_VALIDATION: The record supplies no relevant measure, indicator, feature, predictor, determinant, validation design, or evidence-synthesis role.
exclusion_reason_vocabulary.E_DUPLICATE: The record is a duplicate of an already assigned screening unit.
exclusion_reason_vocabulary.E_INSUFFICIENT_METADATA: The supplied title and abstract are insufficient to determine eligibility; use only after the available text has been examined.

mapping_rule: Use exactly one listed exclusion code for every exclude decision and no exclusion code for include or uncertain. Do not invent aliases, longer variants, or suffixes.
evidence_rule: Except when both title and abstract are genuinely absent and E_INSUFFICIENT_METADATA is used, language_evidence and evidence_span must be exact nonblank title or abstract substrings.
provenance_rule: For artifacts governed by this composite protocol, row-level independent_ai_prompt_sha256 and manifest prompt_sha256 must equal the SHA-256 of this JSON file.
